about_the_game:
Face the Elder’s Trials

Seasons of Solitude is a turn-based survival strategy set in a hand-painted prehistoric world inspired by Estonian nature and myth. You are in exile. Each deliberately designed trial demands foresight: read the land, endure its creatures, and keep the ecosystem in fragile balance as shifting seasons reshape every move. Secure what you find at camp, outmaneuver hazards, and carry hard-won resources forward to unlock tools and strategies for the next challenge.

Scout the Unknown: Every trial begins in uncertainty. Reveal the land tile by tile, uncovering resources you need and hazards that threaten to cut you off. The sooner you know the shape of the world, the better you can survive it.

Gather With Purpose: Food, water, and materials will not last forever. Seasons turn, yields fade, and dangers spread. Take what you can while the opportunity lasts, and weigh every step against hunger, thirst, and time.

Secure Your Gains: What you carry is never safe. Animals contest the same ground, and the state of the land itself shifts against you. Only by bringing resources back to shelter can you protect them from loss and carry them forward into the trials ahead. Every piece you secure strengthens your tools and widens your strategies.

Adapt and Evolve: No trial stands still. A clear path today may freeze tomorrow, and each trial leaves you stronger. Unlock new tools between runs, gain new actions, and adapt your strategy as hazards roam, water dries, and frost creeps across the land.

Key Features

  • Every Trial is a Designed Challenge
    Each map is deliberately built as a focused survival scenario. The levels are not procedurally generated, but the shifting map state and multiple approaches make them replayable. Paths open and close as seasons turn, forcing you to adjust strategy and find your own way through.

  • Seasons That Fight Back
    Summer feeds you, autumn starves you. The bog slows your feet, frost blocks your path, and drought steals your water, every change demands a new plan.

  • Securing What You Gather

    A resource in your hands is never safe. Animals contest the same ground, and the land itself shifts against you. Only by storing gains at camp are they protected from loss and carried into the trials ahead.

  • Survival With Memory
    What you save in one trial shapes the next. Resources carried forward unlock tools that open entirely new actions and strategies.

  • The Land Judges You
    Overuse it and it withers. Protect it and it thrives, rewarding you with better yields and safer paths. The ecosystem remembers your choices.

  • A World Worth Enduring
    Hand-painted tiles inspired by Estonian nature and mythology bring the trials to life,  every tile is beautiful, every step is dangerous.

A World Where Solitude Tests Your Limits
No tribe. No second chances. Only your decisions shape your survival. Explore, adapt, and endure, the Elder is watching.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 or AMD RX 5700 / RX 6600
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
